text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas. Also known as the holidays. A 
special day celebrated merrily by many 
inhabitants of the Earth, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if Neo Universe feels like 
celebrating. After all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a matter of perspective. From space, 
it might be nothing more than an 
insignificant, single rotation.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Neo Universe wants to give a 
"Christmas present."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... it seems Neo Universe did have 
a concept of Christmas after all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: So…… Crouch down—and close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "KICS"... Close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without quite understanding, I closed my 
eyes. After standing still for a moment... 
on my forehead...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt something cold touch me. This is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe's fingertips. Or perhaps 
something—a cold instrument."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"With this... I can 'soar.' Right to the 
place... where we first met."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, my consciousness was... 
blown away somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place I had set foot upon—was 
somewhere primitive.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe wants to share the 
"origin."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A 'REEN' between Umamusume and 'human'... 
One that transcends the boundaries of 
individuals."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In terms of timeline... that was 5,000 
revolutions ago.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Around this time... we met. Post-Neo 
Universe, and you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I will just—run. You will just—watch over 
me."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
We're like an unrequited... "Adam and 
Eve."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
After a while, Neo Universe and the others 
learned how to "collaborate"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it "bore fruit" in the 
field work. Do you get why we joined hands 
now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I started farming alongside someone I 
held unrequited feelings for. The reason 
being—"
choice_data_list: Is it because I've started to feel love?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because I... "love" carrots. Very much.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, the times "we" raced through 
weren't always so peaceful.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Steel in hand, we raced together across a 
thousand miles. Over mountains, across 
valleys—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There were times I was caught in a "meteor 
shower" and collapsed. But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I wasn't lonely. Because I'm "WENH"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because I was able to embark on my journey 
while gazing up at the starry sky 
together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, "technology" advanced, and the 
Neo Universes' "collaboration" ceased to 
exist.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "To plow" and "to fight." However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I'll always be by your side, 
okay? ...As 'ZEER.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was quite a grand story. However, 
there is one thing that still bothers me.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Decoherence, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"There are no boundaries. It's all a 
matter of whether you see things as a line 
or as a plane."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems to be a bond that has continued 
across every universe. The connection with 
the Umamusume is profound.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And now, Neo Universe and her Trainer 
are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Jingle jingle jingle)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We are at the very edge of that timeline. 
At the absolute forefront—of our species."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because of the "tide," we can spend 
Christmas together. Just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sense of reverence washed over me. Who 
we are today is built upon countless 
layers of history accumulated over 
eternity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the very end of all the predecessors 
who shared their heartfelt feelings...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This is—still midway through the journey. 
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The location is—Unknown. In other words... 
we're "lost."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected failure to return. An 
unexpected Christmas exile.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe... is about to 
freeze...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... I demand that you 'stay by my 
side'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We huddled close for a while to fend off 
the cold. A Christmas like this isn't bad. 
Actually, no, it's terrible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Jingle jingle jingle)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We are at the very edge of that timeline. 
At the absolute forefront—of our species."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because of the "tide," we can spend 
Christmas together. Just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sense of reverence washed over me. Who 
we are today is built upon countless 
layers of history accumulated over 
eternity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the very end of all the predecessors 
who shared their heartfelt feelings...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe wants to...... 
'Celebrate'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to 'ruminate' on happiness. 
Continuing all the way from the invention 
of the wheel..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—An artificial path of stars. To walk upon 
it... is what makes me "SISR"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Together with my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path goes on forever. This Christmas 
walk is a gift bestowed by five thousand 
years of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Silver stars will continue to fall upon 
the path walked alongside the Umamusume.
